lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a series of roughly equidistant vertical columns posterior to the branchial slits, forming a structured 2D grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice-like arrangement where blobs serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance contrast with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge transitioning into shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the upper anterior flank posterior to the head; a large number of small, silver-and-yellow fish are present in the foreground, partially occluding the lower flank and pectoral area.
